actions.saveAs: Saves the project with another name or in another folder
actions.close: Closes the project, asking first whether to save the changes
actions.export: Opens the Export step to save the finished image
actions.undo: Undoes the last change to the image
actions.history: Opens and closes the list of changes (the history)
actions.fit: Fits the image to the window
actions.actualSize: Actual size: one image pixel for each screen pixel
actions.compare: While held down, shows the image as it was when opened; releasing it returns to the processed one (before and after comparison)
actions.markers: Shows or hides the catalog object markers
actions.stars: Shows or hides the detected stars
actions.crop: Shows or hides the crop box in the viewer; when shown, you can move and resize it with the mouse
actions.clipping: Shows or hides the clipped pixels: pure black in blue, pure white in magenta
actions.panel: Shows or hides the tool panel (if a control is focused from the keyboard, Tab moves to the next one)
actions.fullScreen: Full screen, and back to the window
actions.step2: Step 2, Calibrate: darks, flats and bias frames
actions.step3: Step 3, Stack: aligns and combines the frames
actions.step4: Step 4, Process: sky background, color, noise, detail, stars
actions.step5: Step 5, Correct: stretch, tones and color
actions.step7: Step 7, Objects: the objects in the field
actions.step8: Step 8, Export: saves the finished image
actions.stretch: Stretch: computes a black point and midtones suited to the image
actions.reset: Reset: returns the image to how it was when opened (Ctrl+Z takes you back)
actions.brush: Mask brush of the selected local adjustment (B again to go back to panning)
actions.eraser: Mask eraser of the selected local adjustment (E again to go back to panning)
actions.showMask: Shows or hides in red the mask of the selected local adjustment
actions.shortcutList: Opens and closes this list of shortcuts

words.clipping: clipping clipped blown burnt saturated black white warning

reminders.wheel: Zooms in and out toward the point under the pointer
reminders.drag: Moves the image in the viewer
reminders.esc: Closes the open window or menu
reminders.arrows: In menus: move through the items and from one menu to another; Enter runs the item
